mapper.select: SELECT sr.id, sr.reservation_no AS reservationNo, sr.user_id AS userId, sr.spot_id AS spotId, sr.visit_date AS visitDate, sr.visit_time_slot AS visitTimeSlot, sr.visitor_count AS visitorCount, sr.contact_name AS contactName, sr.contact_mobile AS contactMobile, sr.status, sr.qr_token_hash AS qrTokenHash, sr.qr_expires_at AS qrExpiresAt, sr.verified_count AS verifiedCount, sr.remark, sr.created_at AS createdAt, sr.updated_at AS updatedAt, ss.name AS spotName, ss.address AS spotAddress, ss.opening_hours AS spotOpeningHours, ss.images AS spotImages, ss.status AS spotStatus, sc.id AS categoryId, sc.name AS categoryName, sc.code AS categoryCode, sc.icon_url AS categoryIconUrl FROM scenic_reservation sr LEFT JOIN scenic_spot ss ON sr.spot_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON ss.category_id = sc.id WHERE sr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sr.created_at DESC

SELECT sr.id, sr.reservation_no AS reservationNo, sr.user_id AS userId, sr.spot_id AS spotId, sr.visit_date AS visitDate, sr.visit_time_slot AS visitTimeSlot, sr.visitor_count AS visitorCount, sr.contact_name AS contactName, sr.contact_mobile AS contactMobile, sr.status, sr.qr_token_hash AS qrTokenHash, sr.qr_expires_at AS qrExpiresAt, sr.verified_count AS verifiedCount, sr.remark, sr.created_at AS createdAt, sr.updated_at AS updatedAt, ss.id AS spotId2, ss.name AS spotName, ss.brief AS spotBrief, ss.description AS spotDescription, ss.address AS spotAddress, ss.longitude AS spotLongitude, ss.latitude AS spotLatitude, ss.images AS spotImages, ss.opening_hours AS spotOpeningHours, ss.status AS spotStatus, sc.id AS categoryId, sc.name AS categoryName, sc.code AS categoryCode, sc.icon_url AS categoryIconUrl, su.id AS userId2, su.nickname AS nickname, su.mobile AS userMobile, su.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, su.openid AS openid, su.unionid AS unionid, su.status AS userStatus FROM scenic_reservation sr LEFT JOIN scenic_spot ss ON sr.spot_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON ss.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON sr.user_id = su.id WHERE sr.id = #{id}
